new_nodes.label: Card-selected cooking
new_nodes.detail: Replaces timer and power knobs.

ideas.rationale: Choosing a card is simpler than programming settings.

ideas.title: RFID Cookware Auto-Power

new_nodes.label: Cookware RFID preference
new_nodes.detail: Microwave-safe dish carries its recommended power setting.

new_nodes.label: Dish-driven power selection
new_nodes.detail: Replaces power knob.

ideas.rationale: The dish chooses the setting, so users do not learn power levels.

ideas.title: One-Minute Push Button

new_nodes.label: One-minute push button
new_nodes.detail: Each press adds exactly one minute and starts.

new_nodes.label: Count-based timer
new_nodes.detail: Replaces rotary timer.

ideas.rationale: Pressing a big button repeatedly is instantly understood.

ideas.title: No-Panel Auto-Cook Microwave

new_nodes.label: Multi-sensor auto-cook
new_nodes.detail: Weight, humidity, and IR detect food and cook it.

new_nodes.label: Panel-free cooking
new_nodes.detail: No controls except open and close.

ideas.rationale: No control panel means nothing to learn.

ideas.title: Single Everything Button

new_nodes.label: Everything button
new_nodes.detail: One button opens, starts, and auto-cooks based on sensors.

new_nodes.label: Universal one-press operation
new_nodes.detail: Replaces all knobs, switches, and start controls.

ideas.rationale: One button makes the microwave as simple as a light switch.

ideas.title: One-Press Auto-Cook

new_nodes.label: One-Press Cook Button
new_nodes.detail: Replaces timer and power knobs with a single press; sensors choose time and power.

new_nodes.label: Auto-Program Cooking
new_nodes.detail: Detects load and runs an optimal cycle without user settings.

ideas.rationale: A single press removes all timer and power decisions, making operation instantly intuitive.

ideas.title: Push Door Replaces Release Button

new_nodes.label: Push-Open Door Panel
new_nodes.detail: The door itself springs open when pushed, eliminating a separate release button.

new_nodes.label: Direct Door Opening
new_nodes.detail: User pushes the same surface they already touch to open the microwave.

ideas.rationale: Removing the separate release button eliminates a learned action and a small part.

ideas.title: Foot-Pedal Door Release

new_nodes.label: Foot Pedal Latch
new_nodes.detail: A floor-level pedal opens the door without hands or searching for a button.

new_nodes.label: Hands-Free Door Opening
new_nodes.detail: User steps on pedal to open, useful when carrying food.

ideas.rationale: A pedal is a single obvious action that removes hand-eye coordination and button learning.

ideas.title: Transparent Casing, No Interior Lamp

new_nodes.label: Clear Microwave Body
new_nodes.detail: Transparent shell lets ambient light show food without an internal bulb.

new_nodes.label: Passive Interior Visibility
new_nodes.detail: User sees inside without operating a light or a window.

ideas.rationale: No lamp means no bulb to burn out and no light-related controls, simplifying the product.

ideas.title: Camera-in-Door with Magnified Screen

new_nodes.label: Door Camera and Simple Screen
new_nodes.detail: A fixed camera shows a magnified view, replacing both window holes and lamp.

new_nodes.label: Always-On Food View
new_nodes.detail: User glances at a clear screen without peering through small holes.

ideas.rationale: The screen is self-explanatory and removes the need to interpret a dark window.

ideas.title: Motion-Sensing Start

new_nodes.label: Wave-to-Start Sensor
new_nodes.detail: A hand wave starts a default safe cook cycle, replacing knobs and buttons.

new_nodes.label: Gesture-Initiated Cooking
new_nodes.detail: No controls to learn; the user simply waves near the door.

ideas.rationale: A gesture is universally understood and replaces all programming steps.

ideas.title: Voice-Command Only Control

new_nodes.label: Simple Voice Module
new_nodes.detail: Only three commands: cook, defrost, stop.

new_nodes.label: Spoken Microwave Operation
new_nodes.detail: User says one word instead of turning or pressing controls.

ideas.rationale: Voice replaces all physical programming with natural language.

ideas.title: NFC Tap-to-Cook

new_nodes.label: NFC Tap Reader
new_nodes.detail: Tap a phone or tag to load one preset and start.

new_nodes.label: One-Tap Recipe Launch
new_nodes.detail: Removes dialing and guessing; a tap sets everything.

ideas.rationale: Tap is a familiar smartphone action, so there is almost no microwave-specific learning.

ideas.title: Barcode Scan Auto-Set

new_nodes.label: Barcode Scanner
new_nodes.detail: Scans packaged food and sets time and power automatically.

new_nodes.label: Package-Driven Cooking
new_nodes.detail: User scans the box just like at a checkout.

ideas.rationale: Scanning an existing barcode removes all need to interpret cooking settings.

ideas.title: QR Code Scan Auto-Set

new_nodes.label: QR Code Camera
new_nodes.detail: Reads a QR code on food packaging to start a preset.

new_nodes.label: Visual Recipe Trigger
new_nodes.detail: User points food at the microwave; no buttons needed.

ideas.rationale: QR scanning is a common phone gesture that makes microwave setup automatic.

ideas.title: RFID Food Tag Auto-Set

new_nodes.label: RFID Reader
new_nodes.detail: Reads an embedded tag on microwave-safe containers.

new_nodes.label: Container-Selected Cooking
new_nodes.detail: The container tells the microwave how to cook its contents.

ideas.rationale: Using tagged containers hides all programming behind an invisible, automatic step.

ideas.title: Weight-Sensor Auto-Power

new_nodes.label: Turntable Weight Sensor
new_nodes.detail: Weighs food and sets power without a power knob.

new_nodes.label: Automatic Power Selection
new_nodes.detail: User places food and presses one start.

ideas.rationale: The power knob disappears, so the user cannot choose a wrong power level.

ideas.title: Moisture-Sensor Auto-Stop

new_nodes.label: Humidity Probe
new_nodes.detail: Stops cooking when moisture indicates food is ready.

new_nodes.label: Doneness-Based Shutdown
new_nodes.detail: No timer to set; the microwave decides when to stop.

ideas.rationale: Automatic stop removes the timer-setting step and the fear of overcooking.

ideas.title: Steam-Sensor Auto-Stop

new_nodes.label: Steam Detector
new_nodes.detail: Detects steam and shuts off when food is hot.

new_nodes.label: Heat-Triggered Stop
new_nodes.detail: User never sets a time; they just start.

ideas.rationale: A steam sensor replaces the timer with an invisible, automatic judgment.

ideas.title: Acoustic Pop Sensor Auto-Stop

new_nodes.label: Pop Sound Microphone
new_nodes.detail: Listens for popping and stops when popping slows.

new_nodes.label: Sound-Based Popcorn Stop
new_nodes.detail: No popcorn button or time entry required.

ideas.rationale: The user just starts it; the microwave listens and stops at the right moment.

ideas.title: Thermal Probe Auto-Stop

new_nodes.label: Infrared Temperature Probe
new_nodes.detail: Reads surface temperature and stops at target doneness.

new_nodes.label: Temperature-Controlled Cooking
new_nodes.detail: No timer settings; only a start action.

ideas.rationale: Temperature replaces time, eliminating the hardest setting to learn.

ideas.title: Single Big One-Minute Button

new_nodes.label: One-Minute Giant Button
new_nodes.detail: A single oversized button adds one minute per press and starts.

new_nodes.label: Add-Minute Cooking
new_nodes.detail: User presses once per minute; no dial or display needed.

ideas.rationale: One giant button is obvious and removes all numeric time entry.

ideas.title: Two-Button Cook and Defrost

new_nodes.label: Cook/Defrost Buttons
new_nodes.detail: Only two labeled buttons replace the full control panel.

new_nodes.label: Binary Cooking Choice
new_nodes.detail: User chooses cook or defrost, nothing else.

ideas.rationale: Two choices are easier than five power levels and a timer.

ideas.title: Pictogram Dial with No Numbers

new_nodes.label: Food Pictogram Dial
new_nodes.detail: Dial shows only food pictures: popcorn, drink, reheat, frozen.

new_nodes.label: Picture-Based Selection
new_nodes.detail: User turns to a picture and presses start.

ideas.rationale: Pictures remove reading and number interpretation from operation.

ideas.title: Color-Coded Food Icons

new_nodes.label: Color Food Keys
new_nodes.detail: Each key has a food color and icon instead of text or numbers.

new_nodes.label: Color-Matched Cooking
new_nodes.detail: User matches food color to button color.

ideas.rationale: Color matching is pre-literate and requires almost no learning.

ideas.title: One-Touch Popcorn

new_nodes.label: Popcorn Touch Pad
new_nodes.detail: A single dedicated pad starts the ideal popcorn cycle.

new_nodes.label: Fixed Popcorn Preset
new_nodes.detail: No time or power choices for popcorn.

ideas.rationale: A single labeled pad makes the most common snack foolproof.

ideas.title: One-Touch Beverage

new_nodes.label: Beverage Touch Pad
new_nodes.detail: One pad heats a standard cup automatically.

new_nodes.label: Fixed Beverage Preset
new_nodes.detail: No need to enter time or power.

ideas.rationale: One dedicated button removes all decisions for a daily task.

ideas.title: One-Touch Reheat

new_nodes.label: Reheat Touch Pad
new_nodes.detail: A single pad reheats a plate using sensors.

new_nodes.label: Fixed Reheat Preset
new_nodes.detail: No time, power, or weight entry.

ideas.rationale: The most common leftover task becomes a single obvious press.

ideas.title: One-Touch Frozen Meal

new_nodes.label: Frozen Meal Pad
new_nodes.detail: A single pad runs a frozen-meal sequence.

new_nodes.label: Fixed Frozen Preset
new_nodes.detail: No need to read package instructions.

ideas.rationale: A dedicated pad hides a multi-step defrost-cook cycle behind one action.

ideas.title: Auto-Detect Food Type

new_nodes.label: Food Type Sensor
new_nodes.detail: Camera or spectroscopy identifies food category automatically.

new_nodes.label: Automatic Food Recognition
new_nodes.detail: User places food and presses start; microwave selects mode.

ideas.rationale: Recognition removes the need to know which setting matches which food.

ideas.title: Auto-Detect Portion Size

new_nodes.label: Portion Camera
new_nodes.detail: Estimates portion size from a top-down image.

new_nodes.label: Automatic Portion Scaling
new_nodes.detail: Time and power adjust automatically to amount.

ideas.rationale: Users no longer guess time based on how much food is inside.

ideas.title: Auto-Detect Doneness

new_nodes.label: Multi-Sensor Doneness Array
new_nodes.detail: Combines temperature, moisture, and sound to judge doneness.

new_nodes.label: Automatic Doneness Judgment
new_nodes.detail: Stops when food is ready, not when a timer ends.

ideas.rationale: The microwave takes over the hardest judgment, so the user only starts it.

ideas.title: Remove Power Knob with Auto Power

new_nodes.label: Auto Power Circuit
new_nodes.detail: Infers power level from food type and weight.

new_nodes.label: Invisible Power Control
new_nodes.detail: No power-level knob or menu exists.

ideas.rationale: Eliminating the power knob removes one of the two main controls.

ideas.title: Remove Timer Knob with Auto Timer

new_nodes.label: Auto Timer Module
new_nodes.detail: Calculates time from sensors instead of a mechanical dial.

new_nodes.label: Invisible Time Control
new_nodes.detail: No timer knob or numbers to set.

ideas.rationale: Removing the timer knob removes the main source of learning and mistakes.

ideas.title: Door Closes to Start

new_nodes.label: Auto-Start Door Latch
new_nodes.detail: Closing the door starts a safe default cook cycle.

new_nodes.label: Close-to-Cook
new_nodes.detail: No start button; the door motion is the start command.

ideas.rationale: The user only performs the natural action of closing the door.

ideas.title: Door Opens to Stop

new_nodes.label: Instant Stop Hinge Switch
new_nodes.detail: Opening the door always stops cooking immediately.

new_nodes.label: Open-to-Stop
new_nodes.detail: No stop button required; the door is the control.

ideas.rationale: Stopping becomes the same action as opening, so no separate control is learned.

ideas.title: Drawer Microwave Replaces Door

new_nodes.label: Pull-Out Drawer Oven
new_nodes.detail: A drawer replaces the hinged door and release button.

new_nodes.label: Drawer-Style Access
new_nodes.detail: User pulls drawer open and pushes it closed to start.

ideas.rationale: A drawer is a familiar furniture action and removes the door-button interaction.

ideas.title: Auto-Door Push-to-Close

new_nodes.label: Soft-Close Auto Door
new_nodes.detail: A light push closes and latches the door automatically.

new_nodes.label: Effortless Door Closing
new_nodes.detail: No need to press a release or slam the door.

ideas.rationale: Motorized closing removes fiddly latch and release-button learning.

ideas.title: No Turntable, Wave Stirrer

new_nodes.label: Fixed Mode Stirrer
new_nodes.detail: A passive stirrer distributes microwaves without a rotating plate.

new_nodes.label: Turntable-Free Even Heating
new_nodes.detail: User places food anywhere; no plate to align.

ideas.rationale: Removing the turntable removes alignment and cleaning steps.

ideas.title: No Turntable Motor, Mode Stirrer

new_nodes.label: Motorless Stirrer Fan
new_nodes.detail: Uses microwave field motion instead of a turntable motor.

new_nodes.label: Motorless Even Heating
new_nodes.detail: No rotating parts or plate to position.

ideas.rationale: Fewer moving parts mean nothing to align or learn about.

ideas.title: Fixed Ceramic Plate, No Turntable

new_nodes.label: Flat Ceramic Floor
new_nodes.detail: A fixed ceramic floor replaces the removable turntable.

new_nodes.label: Place-Anywhere Heating
new_nodes.detail: User does not need to center food on a rotating plate.

ideas.rationale: A fixed floor removes the turntable alignment step entirely.

ideas.title: Rotating Antenna Replaces Turntable

new_nodes.label: Rotating Antenna
new_nodes.detail: The antenna rotates to distribute microwaves instead of moving the food.

new_nodes.label: Antenna-Swept Heating
new_nodes.detail: Food stays still; user never touches a turntable.

ideas.rationale: Moving the hidden antenna instead of the visible plate simplifies loading.

ideas.title: Stirrer Fan Replaces Turntable

new_nodes.label: Wave Stirrer Fan
new_nodes.detail: A metal fan stirs microwave energy for even heating without rotation.

new_nodes.label: Static Food Heating
new_nodes.detail: User places any dish flat and cooks.

ideas.rationale: No turntable means no plate to remove, wash, or align.

ideas.title: Luminescent Interior Walls No Lamp

new_nodes.label: Glow-in-the-Dark Lining
new_nodes.detail: Interior walls glow softly after charging, replacing the lamp.

new_nodes.label: Passive Interior Light
new_nodes.detail: User sees inside without a lamp switch or bulb.

ideas.rationale: No lamp means no bulb-related controls or replacement learning.

ideas.title: LED Strip No Bulb

new_nodes.label: Always-On Low-Power LED Strip
new_nodes.detail: A simple LED strip lights the interior without a replaceable bulb.

new_nodes.label: Maintenance-Free Visibility
new_nodes.detail: User sees food clearly without thinking about a lamp.

ideas.rationale: A permanent LED strip removes bulb replacement and light-button complexity.

ideas.title: Electroluminescent Film No Bulb

new_nodes.label: Electroluminescent Door Film
new_nodes.detail: A glowing film on the door illuminates the interior uniformly.

new_nodes.label: Flat-Panel Interior Light
new_nodes.detail: No bulb, socket, or lamp cover to interact with.

ideas.rationale: The lighting is built into a surface, so there is nothing extra to operate or replace.

ideas.title: Magnetic Auto-Lock Replaces Interlock

new_nodes.label: Magnetic Door Catch
new_nodes.detail: Magnets align and latch the door automatically.

new_nodes.label: Automatic Door Locking
new_nodes.detail: User just pushes the door shut; no latch fiddling.

ideas.rationale: A magnetic catch makes closing and locking feel like a refrigerator door.

ideas.title: Whole-Door Press Replaces Button

new_nodes.label: Whole-Door Release Panel
new_nodes.detail: Pressing anywhere on the door edge releases it.

new_nodes.label: Anywhere-Press Opening
new_nodes.detail: No small button to locate or press.

ideas.rationale: Making the whole door a button removes precision and learning.

ideas.title: Kick-to-Open Door

new_nodes.label: Kick Plate Latch
new_nodes.detail: A low kick plate opens the door with a gentle nudge.

new_nodes.label: Foot-Operated Opening
new_nodes.detail: User can open the door without hands or looking.

ideas.rationale: A kick plate is a single, low-attention action for opening.

ideas.title: Voice Announcer Replaces Bell

new_nodes.label: Voice Chip
new_nodes.detail: Speaks 'done' instead of ringing a mechanical bell.

new_nodes.label: Spoken Completion Alert
new_nodes.detail: User immediately understands the state without interpreting a bell.

ideas.rationale: A spoken word is clearer and simpler than a mechanical ding.

ideas.title: Melody Chime Replaces Bell

new_nodes.label: Soft Melody Chime
new_nodes.detail: A short pleasant melody signals completion.

new_nodes.label: Recognizable Completion Sound
new_nodes.detail: User recognizes the tune instantly.

ideas.rationale: A distinct melody removes ambiguity about whether the microwave is done.

ideas.title: Visual Countdown Ring Replaces Display

new_nodes.label: Colored Countdown Ring
new_nodes.detail: A ring of light shrinks as cooking progresses.

new_nodes.label: At-a-Glance Time Remaining
new_nodes.detail: No numbers to read or understand.

ideas.rationale: A shrinking light ring is intuitive and requires no numeric literacy.

ideas.title: Hourglass Timer Visual

new_nodes.label: Sand-Style Light Timer
new_nodes.detail: Lights fall like sand to show remaining time.

new_nodes.label: Analogical Time Display
new_nodes.detail: User sees time passing without numbers.

ideas.rationale: An hourglass metaphor is understood at a glance and needs no instruction.

ideas.title: Single Knob On/Off Only

new_nodes.label: On/Off Twist Knob
new_nodes.detail: One knob only turns the microwave on or off.

new_nodes.label: Binary Power Control
new_nodes.detail: No time or power selection; sensors handle the rest.

ideas.rationale: A single on/off knob is the simplest possible physical control.

ideas.title: Closing Door Starts Smart Cook

new_nodes.label: Smart Cook Door Trigger
new_nodes.detail: Closing the door starts a sensor-driven smart cook cycle.

new_nodes.label: Zero-Button Cooking
new_nodes.detail: The only user action is placing food and closing the door.

ideas.rationale: If closing the door is the only action, there is literally no control panel to learn.
